messages:
incident-bot: PAGED @channel P1 — SmartRouting policy triggered large-scale spillover. Service: inference-router. Symptom: a subset of Dedicated-tenant traffic is being routed to Hosted pool and then falling back repeatedly, causing hosted capacity exhaustion and tenant isolation bleed. Alert: high 5xx rate on hosted pool and dedicated pool underutilized. https://internal.incidents/1761234567

eva-oncall: investigating, grabbing pager. currently seeing 503s for tenant corp-alpha and higher latency for corp-beta.

leo-sre: I see the router logs showing fallback decisions flip-flopping between regions and tiers. sample log: 
```
2026-03-15T09:02:31Z router[smarter]: route_decision tenant=corp-alpha req_id=abc-789 from_tier=dedicated chosen_tier=hosted reason=fallback_after_timeout fallback_chain=[dedicated,hosted]
2026-03-15T09:02:31Z router[smarter]: fallback_attempt tenant=corp-alpha next_region=eu-west-1 status=failed -> retrying fallback to us-east-1
```

sam-rt: quick summary: a recent policy tweak (PR #4521) changed the precedence semantics for capacity-tier routing. The policy store now returns fallback_order as a stable set, but the router expects an ordered list. That mismatch is causing it to interpret fallback_order as unordered — effectively prioritizing hosted first in some code paths. Result: requests that should stay in Dedicated are eligible for Hosted, triggering spillover.

nora-ml: also saw model-variant mismatches in the logs: requests for model=redwood-base-8b@dedicated were served by redwood-8b-quant@hosted causing semantic drift for customers. Some evals failed.

ally-support: support ticket queue spiking. Customers complaining: "model outputs are different" and timeouts. 3 enterprise customers flagged: corp-alpha (major), corp-beta, corp-gamma.

leo-sre: reproducer found: apply policy_config with fallback_order as a set (JSON object) and router will choose first map iteration key which is non-deterministic. Example bad config: 
```
{
  "tenant": "corp-alpha",
  "allowed_tiers": ["dedicated"],
  "fallback_order": {"hosted": {}, "dedicated": {}}
}
```
should be: 
```
{
  "tenant": "corp-alpha",
  "allowed_tiers": ["dedicated"],
  "fallback_order": ["dedicated","hosted"]
}
```

sam-rt: root cause looks like a JSON/YAML serialization change in the policy-store library during the policy cache refresh path. When the config was serialized into the store it lost ordering. Router code didn't validate the type. Consequence: capacity-tier routing errors + region fallback loop because region fallback logic depends on tier decisions.

ops-bot: Paging update: incident declared P1 at 09:03 UTC. Current responders: eva-oncall, leo-sre, sam-rt.

eva-oncall: mitigation plan, step 1 remove live policy refresh to stop new bad configs from rolling out. step 2 reconfigure affected tenants to manual override directing to dedicated pool. step 3 scale dedicated pool temporarily. step 4 rollback policy-store change. step 5 validate.

ellie-eng: I'm taking lead for coordination. assigning tasks: leo-sre -> live mitigation + logs, sam-rt -> policy-store rollback PR, nora-ml -> model variant checks, ally-support -> customer comms.

leo-sre: Applying manual override now for corp-alpha and corp-beta. Command: 
```
curl -X PUT "https://admin.internal/api/v1/route/override" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant":"corp-alpha","force_tier":"dedicated","reason":"incident 1761234567"}'
```

ally-support: sending holding message to corp-alpha and corp-beta: "We're investigating elevated errors and routing anomalies. We're applying a fix; we'll update in 15 minutes."

sam-rt: rolling back the policy-store serialization change now (reverting commit 7f4b2c1). Pushing hotfix to policy-store and invalidating cache.

leo-sre: scaled dedicated pool +20% to absorb backlog. Confirming new capacity shows up in router metrics.

nora-ml: verifying model variant integrity: scanning last 10k calls for corp-alpha — ~18% were served by hosted quant variant. Collecting diffs for QA.

eva-oncall: monitoring metrics. Hosted 5xx rate beginning to drop after manual overrides. Some customers still seeing higher latency while caches warm.

ops-bot: Note: automated fallback loop detector triggered at 09:07 UTC and temporarily disabled auto-retries for affected tenants to stop churn.

ellie-eng: good. once we confirm traffic stable for 10m we can remove overrides and re-enable policy refresh with validation guards.

sam-rt: hotfix deployed to policy-store at 09:12 UTC, cache invalidated, new ordered fallback lists now present. Verified by dumping policy for corp-alpha: 
```
GET /admin/policies/corp-alpha
=> {"fallback_order":["dedicated","hosted"], "allowed_tiers":["dedicated"]}
```

leo-sre: traffic steadily moving back to dedicated. hosted pool error rate down to baseline.

ally-support: customers updated: corp-alpha acknowledges improvement but asks for RCA and assurance this won't recur.

nora-ml: model evaluation: re-run 100 sample prompts vs baseline. detecting output drift in ~3% of cases that hit hosted quant variant — we've flagged for retroactive billing and quality review.

eva-oncall: marking incident as in mitigation. requesting eng-runtime and eng-platform for postmortem ownership.

ellie-eng: oncall handoff: eva-off at 09:30 UTC, ellie-eng takes over monitoring. Leaving runbook steps in thread.

ally-support: tickets triaged, customers assigned to CSMs, priority follow-ups scheduled.

leo-sre: temporary mitigations removed at 09:40 UTC. Policy refresh re-enabled with stricter validator that rejects non-array fallback_order.

sam-rt: PR to add schema validation to policy-store and router submitted (PR #4530). Also adding a unit test for serialization ordering.

ops-bot: Incident status: Mitigated at 09:44 UTC. Impact: 3 enterprise tenants experienced degraded outputs and elevated errors for ~42 minutes. Approx 120k requests affected; immediate mitigations prevented broader cascading.

ellie-eng: next steps: 1) postmortem doc assigned to eng-runtime (owner: sam-rt), 2) customer RCA draft (owner: ally-support), 3) add integration test to infra-e2e to detect fallback loops, 4) retro billing and quality remediation for affected tenants.

eva-oncall: leaving notes: observed race between cache refresh and policy-store write; serialization change was rolled out without contract tests. Recommend a preflight validation gate for policy changes and deploy-time schema checks.

ally-support: closing comms: "we've applied a fix, revalidated routing, and will share a detailed RCA in 48h."

ellie-eng: closing log: monitoring at normal; will keep watch on policy-store metrics for 24h. Thanks team. :heart:
